definitions.explanation: The visible mist rising from hot water or food. Specifically refers to water vapor that can be seen.

examples.japanese: お{風呂|ふろ}から{湯気|ゆげ}が{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Steam is rising from the bath.

examples.japanese: {熱|あつ}い{料理|りょうり}から{湯気|ゆげ}が{出|で}ている。
examples.english: Steam is coming from the hot food.

examples.japanese: {湯気|ゆげ}で{眼鏡|めがね}が{曇|くも}った。
examples.english: My glasses fogged up from the steam.

notes:
USAGE: Specifically refers to steam from hot water or food - the visible vapor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{湯気|ゆげ}が{立|た}つ (steam rises)
・{湯気|ゆげ}が{出|で}る (steam comes out)
・{湯気|ゆげ}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る (steam rises up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{蒸気|じょうき} - steam (more technical, also for engines)
・{水蒸気|すいじょうき} - water vapor (scientific term)
・{煙|けむり} - smoke (from fire/burning)
